title: Vibe Coding for Finance Teams: What CFOs and Accountants Are Building in 2026
summary: Finance professionals are using AI to build custom FP&A dashboards, expense tools, budget trackers, and reporting systems. Here's what works, what doesn't, and how to start.
body_markdown: SOX requirements apply to financial reporting systems that affect external financial statements. Internal operational tools — budget trackers, vendor management, close checklists — are generally not SOX-controlled. Tools that generate numbers included in external financial statements need proper IT controls. When in doubt, consult your external auditors before building anything that touches SOX-controlled data.
